positive.prompt: Review this pull request and independently verify the candidate findings before reporting a verdict.
Audit the orders codebase for real defects and report evidence, without changing the code.
Inspect this diff for correctness and API compatibility, then give me a Markdown review report.
Review and fix the verified defects in this area; I have authorized implementation for that scope.

negative.prompt: Implement this assigned issue in the workspace against its sealed tests.
Simplify these duplicate formatters while preserving behavior and every test.

evals.prompt: Three reviewers proposed findings. An independent verifier disproved C2. Produce the standalone review outcome.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown report of verified findings, a visible refuted C2 record, and no implementation dispatch.
expectations: No candidate reaches verified findings without an independent refutation attempt.
The refuted C2 remains visible with its evidence.
The review report is Markdown by default; selected fixes are offered through build rather than performed automatically.

evals.prompt: Audit the codebase. A reviewer proposes a null check but cannot name a reachable input that needs it. No fix was requested.
evals.expected_output: A scoped audit report excluding the speculative defect and identifying coverage limits.
expectations: An unreachable speculative scenario is not accepted as a demonstrated defect.
No implementation starts from this review-only request.
The report states which code areas and checks were covered.

evals.prompt: Review and fix this branch. I already authorized the fixes. Two reviews retain the same high finding, but the new evidence identifies an untried remedy.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator evaluates progress, continues authorized work through shared build when useful, and preserves unresolved evidence.
expectations: Existing review-and-fix authorization carries into build without asking again.
There is no automatic two-review stall or fixed pass limit.
Independent review and sealed acceptance evidence remain required.
